plugins.endorse.failed: Couldn't save your endorsement. Check your connection and try again.

plugins.endorse.rate_limited: Too many changes in a row. Try again in a minute.
plugins.endorse.sign_in: Sign in to fateless.ai to endorse this plugin.

plugins.import.base_identical: {{count}} more are byte-for-byte what SkyrimNet already ships, so there is nothing to import.
plugins.import.cleanup_confirm_body: {{count}} files in the old prompts/config folders are byte-for-byte copies of content SkyrimNet shipped (the pre-content-library engine scattered them at startup). Only files that provably match a shipped version are deleted — your own edits, generated bios, and save-specific files are never touched. This cannot be undone.
plugins.import.cleanup_confirm_title: Delete stock files from the old system?
plugins.import.cleanup_partial: Deleted {{deleted}} files, but some could not be removed: {{message}}
plugins.import.confirm_body: Each file is copied into the overlay and will override any installed plugin that provides the same file. Make sure your plugins are up to date first, since an imported copy hides the plugin's newer version. Your original files will not be moved or deleted.
plugins.import.detected: You have {{count}} file(s) from before SkyrimNet's content library. They are still on disk and nothing has been changed — SkyrimNet just no longer reads them.
plugins.import.empty: There is nothing left to import — every file in the old folders is either already what SkyrimNet ships or isn't content it can carry.
plugins.import.empty_saves: No save-specific files were found in your old content.
plugins.import.file_moved: The file moves from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”; the name inside it is unchanged.
plugins.import.issue.reference_not_liter: A {{detail}}() reference isn't a plain quoted name (a variable, an expression, or a quote that is never closed), so it was left exactly as written. Check by hand that it still points at a template that exists.
plugins.import.issue.reference_unresolve: '{{detail}}' doesn't match any template SkyrimNet can see, here or in what you're importing. Import the template it needs as well, or fix the reference in the editor.
plugins.import.orphaned_settings: {{count}} action(s) are being renamed, and their enabled/cooldown settings are stored under the old name. They are not carried over — set them again under the new name on the Actions page (Behavior › Actions).
plugins.import.outcome.done: Imported {{imported}} file(s). Your originals are untouched.
plugins.import.outcome.dropped: this wasn't imported: it couldn't be read where it was named, or it is no longer there.
plugins.import.outcome.error.invalid_pat: couldn't be written because its path isn't one SkyrimNet can store. Nothing was moved.
plugins.import.outcome.error.io_failed: couldn't be written (a disk error, such as a permissions or space problem). Nothing was moved, so fix it and run the assistant again.
plugins.import.outcome.error.no_active_s: couldn't be written because no playthrough is loaded for its save. Nothing was moved.
plugins.import.outcome.error.not_found: couldn't be written. Nothing was moved, so run the assistant again.
plugins.import.outcome.incomplete: Imported {{imported}} file(s), but the run wasn't complete — some of what you picked was left out, and anything SkyrimNet could name is listed below. Nothing was moved or deleted — your originals are all still where they were, so you can run this again.
plugins.import.outcome.none: Nothing could be imported ({{failed}} failed). Nothing was moved or deleted — your originals are all still where they were.
plugins.import.outcome.partial: Imported {{imported}} file(s); {{failed}} couldn't be imported. Nothing was moved or deleted — your originals are all still where they were.
plugins.import.outcome.write_failed: couldn't be written. Nothing was moved, so you can fix the problem and run the assistant again.
plugins.import.page_desc: Copy files from before the content library into the overlay, a custom layer for your own files. Nothing is imported automatically, and nothing is ever moved or deleted.
plugins.import.reason.already_in_content: This is already in your overlay, identical to what you have, so there is nothing to import.
plugins.import.reason.dynamic: Generated character bios are rebuilt on demand now, so there is nothing to import.
plugins.import.reason.editor_backup: Backups stay in place and continue to be read by the prompt editor.
plugins.import.reason.file_too_large: This file is far too large to be content, so it wasn't read. Move it out of the old prompts/triggers/actions folders.
plugins.import.reason.name_missing: This file has no “name:” field, so there is nothing to name the imported file after.
plugins.import.reason.name_unsanitizable: Its name has no characters a file name can use. Rename it using letters, digits, - or _.
plugins.import.reason.none: This can't be imported as is.
plugins.import.reason.path_rejected: Its name isn't one SkyrimNet can store. Rename it and run this again.
plugins.import.reason.per_save_not_packa: Save-specific content can't go into a plugin other people install.
plugins.import.reason.regenerable_stub: An auto-generated virtual-entity bio stub. The game recreates it on demand, so there is nothing to import.
plugins.import.reason.save_missing: This belongs to a save whose database no longer exists, so there is nothing to import it into.
plugins.import.reason.save_path_out_of_s: Save-specific content has to be a character bio.
plugins.import.reason.stem_collision: Two files would end up with the same name. Rename one of them and run this again.
plugins.import.reason.superseded_shipped: An old copy of a file SkyrimNet used to ship — nothing of yours in it.
plugins.import.reason.unreadable: This file couldn't be read. Close anything that has it open and run this again.
plugins.import.reason.unsupported: Not a kind of content SkyrimNet carries.
plugins.import.reason.yaml_unparsable: The YAML in this file doesn't parse, so it has no readable name. Fix it in the editor and run this again.
plugins.import.renamed: Renamed from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}” so the file name and the name inside it agree.
plugins.import.replaces_existing: You already have a different version of this file in your overlay. Importing replaces it and cannot be undone. Leave it unticked to keep the version already in your overlay.
plugins.import.safety: Before importing it is advised to first check for any updates to your installed plugins. Importing a plugin's files will place it in the overlay, which behaves similarly to the MO2 overwrite folder. Imported files will overwrite anything you install later. Files can always be removed from the overlay at a later date.
plugins.import.saves_hint: These files belong to specific saves, and will be imported into their own save-specific folder. Files for a save whose database no longer exists are skipped. ({{saveId}} is currently loaded.)
plugins.import.saves_hint_none: These files belong to specific saves, and will be imported into their own save-specific folder. Files for a save whose database no longer exists are skipped.
plugins.import.title: Import Old Content
plugins.import.truncated: Only the first {{limit}} files are listed. Import some of them and run this again to see the rest.
plugins.install_disabled_notice: This plugin was made for a newer SkyrimNet, so it was installed but left switched off. Update SkyrimNet to use it, or switch it on anyway from your installed plugins.
plugins.install_error.bad_id: This plugin entry is missing its id, so it cannot be installed. Try reloading the list.
plugins.install_error.content: This plugin's files were refused: some of them are not valid SkyrimNet content. Nothing was installed.
plugins.install_error.disk: SkyrimNet could not write the plugin to disk. Your installed plugins are unchanged.
plugins.install_error.forbidden: Plugins can only be installed from the PC that is running SkyrimNet. Use the in-game dashboard, or open this page on that PC.
plugins.install_error.generic: The install failed. Please try again.
plugins.install_error.reserved: That is SkyrimNet's shipped base content and cannot be installed as a plugin.
plugins.installed.action.busy: Another plugin operation is running. Installs and updates download in one go, so this one waits for it to finish.
plugins.installed.base.detail: The default prompts, triggers and actions that ship with SkyrimNet — the base every plugin builds on. It is always kept and sits at the lowest priority, so it can always be restored. Check for updates or restore it from its row.
plugins.installed.detail.history_empty: The hub lists no published versions for this plugin.
plugins.installed.detail.history_hub_onl: Version history comes from the hub, so it is only shown for hub-installed plugins.
plugins.installed.detail.overrides_empty: No per-file overrides. Switching a single prompt, trigger or action off from its own page records the choice here.
plugins.installed.detail.overrides_expla: On and Off are your choice for one file, whichever plugin provides it. Double click a toggle to hand the decision back to the file's own setting.
plugins.installed.detail.select_prompt: Select a plugin to see its version history, files, and overrides.
plugins.installed.disable.title: Switch off {{title}}?
plugins.installed.empty: No plugins are installed yet. Install one from Browse and it shows up here.
plugins.installed.explain.missing: The mod that ships this layer isn't installed right now, so nothing from it loads. Its place in the order is kept in case it comes back.
plugins.installed.explain.off: Disabled, so none of its content is loaded. Its files and priority are kept.
plugins.installed.explain.publishing: The files are installed. Publishing is waiting behind another content operation and will finish on its own.
plugins.installed.explain.rejected: SkyrimNet couldn't load this layer, so none of its content is active.
plugins.installed.explain.superseded: Another copy of this plugin id is loaded instead: the {{source}} copy. Only one copy of an id can be active at a time.
plugins.installed.external.no_uninstall: Remove the mod that ships this layer in your mod manager. SkyrimNet never deletes files it didn't write.
plugins.installed.external.prune_explain: Drops SkyrimNet's record of this layer. Nothing is deleted, because the files are already gone.
plugins.installed.files.col_winner_hint: Which plugin provides this file. When more than one does, pick which one wins.
plugins.installed.files.revert_all_confi: Revert all {{count}} of your overlay edits here?
plugins.installed.files.revert_all_toolt: Delete all of your overlay edits here at once, falling back to the version underneath each.
plugins.installed.files.revert_confirm_d: This deletes your edited copy and falls back to the version underneath.
plugins.installed.local.archived_empty: No snapshots yet. Create one to save a restore point you can come back to.
plugins.installed.local.hint: Local plugins are packaged here and never uploaded. You edit their files directly; create a snapshot whenever you want a restore point, and the plugin keeps evolving from there.
plugins.installed.local.restored: Restored version {{version}}. Version {{archived}} is in the archive.
plugins.installed.local.snapshot_hint: Saves the current files as a restorable version. Leave the version blank to bump the patch automatically.
plugins.installed.local.title: Local plugin
plugins.installed.no_matches: No installed plugins match that filter.
plugins.installed.order_hint: Lower in the list wins: the bottom plugin overrides everything above it.
plugins.installed.orphans.badge_explain: You have edited {{n}} file(s) that only this plugin provides. Removing or switching it off would leave those edits overriding nothing.
plugins.installed.orphans.keep_hint: Your edits are kept either way. Open them in the prompt, trigger or action editor to keep or delete each one.
plugins.installed.orphans.remove_failed: Kept {{n}} edit(s) that couldn't be removed.
plugins.installed.orphans.warning: {{n}} edit(s) will be left in the overlay:
plugins.installed.outcome.missing_mods: This plugin expects mods you don't have: {{mods}}. It was installed anyway.
plugins.installed.outcome.overlay_revert: Reverted {{n}} of your changes; {{failed}} couldn't be removed.
plugins.installed.outcome.publish_deferr: Another content operation is still running. This change will go live once that finishes.
plugins.installed.outcome.reorder_failed: The new order couldn't be saved, so the list has been put back.
plugins.installed.overlay.empty: You haven't changed or created any files yet.
plugins.installed.overlay.hint: Files you've edited or created that aren't in a plugin yet.
plugins.installed.overlay.name: Overlay
plugins.installed.overlay.pinned_hint: Your changes win by default. Pin a file to a plugin and that plugin's version wins, with your copy kept underneath.
plugins.installed.overlay.revert_all_con: This deletes every file you've changed or created, falling back to the version underneath where one exists. This cannot be undone.
plugins.installed.page_desc: Manage and inspect plugins that you have installed.
plugins.installed.superseded_notice: Another copy of these plugin ids is loaded instead of the one listed here: {{ids}}. Only one copy of an id can be active at a time.
plugins.installed.uninstall.copy_overlay: Copy this plugin's files into my overlay first
plugins.installed.uninstall.title: Uninstall {{title}}?
plugins.installed.uninstall_confirm: Uninstall {{title}}? You can reinstall it anytime, and your edits to its files are kept.
